't Prinske
is a Flemish comic book series created and drawn by
Willy Vandersteen
. It is Vandersteen's second
gag series
.
The strip appeared in the
Tintin
weekly from December 1953 to October 1959. A total of 14 front plates, 10 stories, and many gags were published. These were all released as comic books.
[
1
]
The comic revolves around the adventures of a young prince and his butler.
Albums
